lead.title: Open WebUI v0.11.4 cuts its slim container by ~89% and adds terminal skills plus AGENTS.md support
lead.summary: The self-hosted chat UI's slim image drops to about 175MB — roughly 89% smaller — by stripping redundant Python environments, bundled models and unused packages, with the standard build shedding about 170MB as well. The release also exposes connected terminal-server skills through the '$'/'/' menus, has models auto-read AGENTS.md in the terminal home directory, and blocks diagrams from referencing external origins.

top_stories.title: M5 Ultra Mac Studio review roundups frame Apple's quad-die desktop as a local AI machine
top_stories.summary: Early reviews of the new M5 Ultra Mac Studio emphasize on-device LLM inference, pointing to unified-memory headroom and GPU bandwidth for large quantized models. Apple claims up to 4.3x faster on-device AI performance versus the prior generation, with top configs offering up to 512GB of unified memory.

top_stories.title: Google's Googlebook line mandates a 40+ TOPS NPU and 16GB RAM for on-device Gemini
top_stories.summary: Built with Acer, ASUS, Dell, HP and Lenovo on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 and Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite, the new laptop class requires a 40-45 TOPS NPU and at least 16GB of high-speed RAM. Multimodal Gemini features run locally on the NPU, and developers get Linux containers plus CLI access.

top_stories.title: ComfyUI v0.37.0 adds MoGe-3 support and faster-disk auto-detection
top_stories.summary: The local image/video generation UI ships MoGe-3 model support, auto-enables --fast-disk when a fast disk is detected, and updates its Qwen3-series text encoders — timely groundwork for running the new open image models locally.

top_stories.title: Qualcomm previews the next Hexagon NPU for Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 ahead of Snapdragon Summit
top_stories.summary: Qualcomm began disclosing the redesigned NPU architecture that will power its next high-end mobile chips, targeting on-device agents and LLMs with higher generative throughput and lower memory traffic.

items.title: SPECTRA adaptively schedules speculative decoding on a runtime-reconfigurable tiled architecture
items.summary: Targets the awkward regime between memory-bound draft decoding and compute-bound verification on edge devices, recovering throughput by co-scheduling draft and verify passes on reconfigurable tiles.

items.title: SPHQuant pushes vision-language models to extreme low-bit weight-only quantization
items.summary: Combines rotation-based outlier handling with memory-efficient decoding to keep native VLMs usable at 2-3 bit weights where rotation-free methods break down.

items.title: Hypernetworks generate per-user LoRA adapters for on-device LLM personalization
items.summary: A hypernetwork emits per-user LoRA adapters for mobile LLMs, exploiting the predictable single-user workload of a phone to fit personalization within tight compute and memory budgets.

items.title: KV-COBRA co-optimizes bit and rank budgets per attention head
items.summary: Argues extreme-rate KV-cache compression is limited by how the bit/rank budget is spread across heads, and beats uniform-budget baselines by co-optimizing rank truncation and scalar quantization per head.

items.title: H-Spec drops the drafter-side KV cache in block-diffusion speculative decoding
items.summary: Removes the per-request drafter KV cache that block-diffusion drafters normally require, cutting drafting latency and memory while staying lossless.

items.title: Yandex open-sources AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B: an 80B MoE trained from scratch, Apache 2.0
items.summary: A 512-expert MoE (about 3B active per token) trained from scratch on roughly 18T tokens with no borrowed initializations, using Kimi Delta Attention in three of every four layers for a 262K-token context. The base model lands at about 45GB in 4-bit and out-performs Nemotron-3-Super-120B on several coding benchmarks despite far fewer active parameters.

items.title: Xiaomi open-sources the MiMo-V2.6 omnimodal models — and the RL machinery behind them
items.summary: Weights, technical report, RL checkpoints, a distilled Qwen-9B companion and verified training practices are all released for the natively omnimodal Pro and Flash variants, pitched as a showcase of scaling RL on verifiable tasks.

items.title: DSpark draft models for Liquid AI's LFM2.5 series claim a 3.18x speculative-decoding speedup
items.summary: Draft-model checkpoints for LFM2.5-1.2B, 2.6B and 8B-A1B lift inference throughput roughly 3.18x while preserving output quality, with day-1 SGLang support and official llama.cpp loading of GGUF weights plus draft files from the command line.

items.title: tokenizers v1: Hugging Face rewrites its tokenizer pipeline around bitstreams
items.summary: The v1 milestone replaces the regex-based pipeline with bitstreams, a word cache and an optimized merge loop, with benchmarks showing encode/decode scaling for large training runs and concurrent serving.

items.title: llama.cpp builds b11090–b11095 ship HMX-optimized gated delta-net kernels for Hexagon
items.summary: The headline change is a new GATED_DELTA_NET implementation using pipelined HMX/DMAS dispatch and HVX vectorization, aimed at Qualcomm's NPU-class offload paths.

items.title: Nanosamurai.ai is an Ollama-style local speech-to-text platform for sensitive audio
items.summary: A Show HN launch pitched as 'Ollama for voice models': fully self-hosted STT for organizations that cannot send conversations to third parties.

items.title: Motif gives coding-agent teams one shared working memory over MCP
items.summary: Sessions from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor become a single queryable graph of decisions and files that any agent can reach over MCP.

items.title: Foremerge catches intent conflicts between parallel coding agents before they become merge conflicts
items.summary: A coordination protocol layered above Git that detects conflicting intents across parallel agents; the day's top-voted agent-tooling post at 39 points.

items.title: AWS open-sources Strands Harness, a deploy-anywhere agent that runs against your own model endpoint
items.summary: A ready-to-use agent built on the Strands Agents SDK that runs locally or in any environment and leans on the model's built-in tools — another agent runtime that can be pointed at a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead of a cloud API.

items.title: Helical Insight hits 1,000 stars: open-source BI with bring-your-own-LLM via local Ollama
items.summary: The Community Edition's natural-language querying can point at a locally hosted Ollama model so query data never leaves the organization — pitched at HIPAA/GDPR-regulated environments.

items.title: Runtime patch wave: Ollama v0.34.2, llama.cpp v0.4.1, ggml v0.24.0, SGLang v0.5.20
items.summary: A week of patch releases across the local-inference stack — new model support, a precision-control API in ggml, improved CUDA/HIP graphs in llamafile — worth pinning container builds to.

items.title: MSI EdgeMesa N AI+ mini PC surfaces: 20-core Nvidia RTX Spark SoC, 128GB LPDDR5x
items.summary: MSI listed the compact desktop with up to 128GB of LPDDR5x-9600 unified memory, 4TB storage and 10GbE networking — a DGX Spark-class appliance, though pricing and availability are still undisclosed.

items.title: MediaTek Dimensity CX C10 Max debuts a 55-TOPS NPU for AI-first laptops
items.summary: A TSMC 3nm flagship in the new Dimensity Compute Experiences family — octa-core all-big CPU, 11-core GPU and an 8th-generation NPU delivering up to 55 TOPS, aimed at fanless ultra-portables that run local Gemini-class models.

items.title: BrainChip ships the AKD1500 PCIe card for ultra-low-power edge AI
items.summary: A self-learning digital neuromorphic co-processor board for desktops, workstations and single-board computers, running models from existing frameworks with open tools and no license fees.
